notes: Reconciles p5-002 discovery and p5-001 manifests into the SQLite library through one WriteAsync transaction under the frozen Steam plugin GUID, matching imported records by plugin id plus canonical app id and using a deterministic version-5 identity for new records. Provider-owned name, install directory, install size and install state only; OverrideInstallState is respected and every other field, including tracker-owned playtime, is preserved. Records are never deleted: an app absent from an authoritative discovery is marked not installed and counted Removed. Every skipped app is reported by id and stable reason; unavailable or incomplete discovery never marks games uninstalled. Review fix: reconciliation is conditional on a complete library parse, so a rejected or truncated library file, an entry the parser drops and an unavailable library without a declared app set each withdraw authority, report library-file-rejected/library-entry-dropped/library-apps-unknown and perform zero removals; integration tests cover all three. Repeat sync over unchanged input reports zero changes. UI-free, network-free, no schema or protected-oracle change.
